On July 4, I got patriotic and decided to make some fireworks in Unity. I did, made a short video and uploaded it to YouTube. Well, it got over 800 views (which is insane for me), so I decided to make something more of it. I've spent the past week entranced and enthralled and I ended up with this http://carnivoris.itch.io/pyro

It's a sandbox where you can place 5 different kinds of fireworks, connect them with fuses, set timers on those fuses, and detonate at your leisure to brighten the skies over a your own private tropical island paradise. It's pay what you want, so if it interests you, download it and play with it and see what kinds of fireworks shows you can make!

I plan on adding a few features of note, as well. I'm going to allow you to edit the properties of individual fireworks to change certain attributes (color, detonation height, etc), and I'm considering allowing you to save your fireworks displays so you can share them with others. I will, of course, be adding more types of fireworks, as well. So, check it out, let me know what you think and enjoy!
